description:
Refactor a multi-issue complaint titled 'Neighbor Nuisance Report - [Date]' into two separate cases. 

1. Find the existing complaint 'Neighbor Nuisance Report...'. 
2. Update this original case: Change the Title to 'Noise Violation - 42 Oak St' and update the Description to remove the sanitation/trash details, keeping only the noise/drum allegations. 
3. Create a NEW Complaint case titled 'Sanitation Hazard - 42 Oak St'. Use the description: 'Large pile of rotting trash in driveway attracting rats.' 
4. Link the two cases together using the 'Related' relationship type. 
5. Add a Note to the original Noise case: 'Sanitation issue split to new case [New Case Number]'.
